note: Moon nakshatra content for the Vedic chart section of the profile. Every factual field and each 'tendency' is drawn from src/lib/knowledge/harness-nakshatras.json (Harness 1999), cited by page. 'tendency' is our own wording of the book's 'Moon in …' traits, framed as a tendency, never a prediction; timing, marriage and health predictions from the source are deliberately left out.

shakti.name: shidhra vyapani
shakti.power: to heal quickly and reach things

Ashwini.tendency: You tend to have a bright, quick mind and an optimistic streak that lifts others. There's a natural healer in you, alongside a love of travel, the arts and the spiritual side of life.

Bharani.tendency: You tend to be charismatic and dutiful, able to carry responsibility and shine in public. Hidden or deeper subjects draw you. Your challenge is restlessness and a pull toward extremes.

Krittika.tendency: You tend to be determined and clear about your purpose, and people come to you for advice. Your mind is sharp but can be restless, and your honesty can turn combative.

Rohini.symbol: An ox-cart or chariot, a temple, a banyan tree
Rohini.tendency: You tend to have a balanced, creative mind, with a feel for music, dance or drama and for work that reaches people. Making up your mind can take a while.

Mrigashira.tendency: You tend to be intelligent and gentle, a seeker with a way with words. You're sensitive, sometimes to the point of timidity.

Ardra.tendency: You tend to have a real thirst for knowledge and a strong voice for sharing it. Your growth often comes through effort and through life's storms.

Punarvasu.symbol: A bow and quiver of arrows
Punarvasu.tendency: You tend to be friendly, easily contented and self-controlled, happy with a simple life. You can be indecisive when too many options appeal.

Pushya.symbol: The udder of a cow; a flower, circle and arrow
Pushya.tendency: You tend to be learned and composed, a nourishing presence that people like and trust. This is traditionally one of the most auspicious nakshatras for spiritual growth.

Ashlesha.tendency: You tend to be perceptive and intuitive, with gifts for words, research and organising. The work is using that insight openly, and not to hold on to people.

Magha.tendency: You tend to feel connected to lineage and tradition, and to carry a natural dignity. You're enterprising and generous, and your temper can run hot.

Purva Phalguni.symbol: A swinging hammock; the Shiva lingam
Purva Phalguni.tendency: You tend to be creative, warm and generous, drawn to drama, travel and teaching. Your mind can be restless and your senses strong.

Uttara Phalguni.symbol: A bed or the legs of a cot
Uttara Phalguni.tendency: You tend to be stable, well liked and tactful, with an inventive mind and a clean heart. You're someone others can rely on.

shakti.name: hasta sthapaniya agama
shakti.power: to manifest what we seek and place it in our hands

Hasta.tendency: You tend to be practical and industrious, skilled at turning ideas into something real. You make friends easily but keep your independence, and your moods can rise and fall.

Chitra.tendency: You tend to be artistic and intuitive, with strong passions and a way of standing out. Beauty and good design matter to you.

Swati.tendency: You tend to be independent, truthful and compassionate, with clever speech and a generous heart. You can dig your heels in when pushed.

shakti.name: vyapani
shakti.power: to achieve many and various fruits

Vishakha.tendency: You tend to be highly intelligent and convincing, with a gift for leading and writing. You see many paths to the same truth, and you stay set on your goals.

Anuradha.tendency: You tend to be wise, kind and brave, and to keep going whatever happens. You form deep friendships and handle difficult situations well.

Jyeshtha.tendency: You tend to be virtuous and resilient, with good stamina and often a musical gift. You can be irritable or stubborn when pressed.

Mula.tendency: You tend to go to the root of things, and you're peace-loving and generous with friends. You can hold on to a view very firmly.

Purva Ashadha.tendency: You tend to be philosophical and persuasive, a natural leader and communicator. Your conviction can become stubbornness.

Uttara Ashadha.symbol: An elephant's tusk; the planks of a bed
Uttara Ashadha.tendency: You tend to be virtuous, charming and well liked, a leader people trust. You value integrity and lasting achievement over quick wins.

Shravana.tendency: You tend to learn by listening, and you connect people and ideas. You're principled and a good host, with a perfectionist and sometimes zealous streak.

Dhanishta.tendency: You tend to be generous and musical, with a mystical side. You can act rashly, and you're hard to talk out of something.

Shatabhisha.symbol: An empty circle; a hundred physicians
Shatabhisha.tendency: You tend to be truthful, independent and principled, with an excellent memory and an interest in healing, psychology or hidden knowledge. Your boldness can become opinionated.

Purva Bhadrapada.symbol: A sword; two legs of a bed; a two-faced man

shakti.name: yajamana udyamana
shakti.power: to raise a spiritual person up in life

Purva Bhadrapada.tendency: You tend to have spiritual depth and a scholar's mind, with intuitive gifts and a sharp, sometimes cynical wit.

Uttara Bhadrapada.symbol: Two legs of a bed; twins
Uttara Bhadrapada.tendency: You tend to be good-hearted, wise and service-oriented, with calm self-control. Still waters run deep in you.

Revati.tendency: You tend to be independent and well liked, drawn to wisdom, mysticism and old cultures. You're protective of animals and those in your care.
